push.title: App notifications
push.description: Receive reminders from all modules in one place.
push.device_hint: This setting applies to every module on this device. Other devices keep their own settings.
push.privacy_hint: Health reminders are discreet by default. You can choose to show medication details below.
push.blocked: Allow notifications in your browser settings to enable them on this device.
push.unconfigured: Notifications are not available in this environment yet. Your reminders remain available in the modules.
push.error: Could not save the preference. Try again.
push.enabled_feedback: Notifications from all modules enabled on this device.
push.disabled_feedback: Notifications from all modules disabled on this device.
push.manage_hint: Enable notifications in the app settings for all modules.
push.medication_details_hint: Applies to your account on all devices. When enabled, the name, time and amount may appear on the lock screen. Previously delivered notifications are unchanged.
push.medication_details_visible: Medication details visible in upcoming notifications.
push.medication_details_hidden: Details hidden. Open the authenticated app to check your dose.
